description: Codex CLI traces sub-pipeline — invoked by the traces-apm@custom router only for service.name=codex_cli_rs, so no service.name guard is needed here. Drops the high-volume streaming leaf/intermediate spans (receiving, handle_responses) before routing, then reroutes the agent's spans to the dedicated traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs data stream (still traces-apm-*, so it keeps the full APM trace mappings). See SPEC/codex-cli-telemetry.md.
